---
title: "Another power function example"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r message = F}
library(tidyverse)
n <- 5
df_ls <- list()
c_vals <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.2)
for(i in 1:length(c_vals)){
  c <- c_vals[i]
  theta_seq <- seq(0, 1.25, 0.01)
  power_func <- 1 - ( (1-theta_seq)^n - (1-c)^n)
  power_func[theta_seq >= c] <- 1
  df_ls[[i]] <- data.frame(power_func, theta_seq, c = c)
}
do.call(rbind, df_ls) |>
  mutate( c = factor(c)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = theta_seq, y = power_func, col = c)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = expression(theta),
       y = expression(pi ( theta ~ "|" ~ delta[c]))) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

```
